articles.summary: The Management Board of Evotec SE today resolved with the approval of the Supervisory Board to launch the offering of senior unsecured convertible bonds due 2033, convertible into new and/or existing no-par value ordinary bearer shares of the Company, in an aggregate principal amount of approximately EUR 125 million.
